To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of a QRS detection algorithm on the ECG signals recorded by a handheld ECG device can be significantly improved by using a device-dependent self-collected ECG database.
the QRS detector developed in our previous work has a high sensitivity and moderate positive predictivity on self-collected 50 short-term 1-min ECG records.

the QRS detection algorithm should be designed to be robust against the noise characteristics of the specific device and the self-collected database is essential to test the performance of the QRS detection algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the ECG analysis algorithms and the ECG database, which is useful for developing the ECG analysis algorithm.
the development of a simple and easy-to-use ECG device for self-diagnosis and self-monitoring of cardiac arrhythmia.
the development of an ambulatory ECG device for the detection of arrhythmias and the development of an algorithm for arrhythmia detection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the self-collected database is very important for the development of ECG analysis and the performance of the QRS detector depends on the characteristics of ECG database.
the self-collected database is indispensable for developing and testing the performance of the algorithm for ECG analysis, especially in a handheld device.
the performance of the algorithm on the device specific database is more reliable than on the MIT-BIH Arrythmia Database.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of a QRS detection algorithm can be significantly improved by using the self-collected database.
the development of ECG device should be accompanied with the development of EEC analysis algorithm.
the performance of a QRS detection algorithm is highly dependent on the noise characteristics of EGC signals, which is different from one ECG device to another.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to develop a QRS detector with a high sensitivity and positive predictivity using a self-collected database from a handheld device.
the self-collected database is very important for the performance evaluation of QRS detector on a specific device.
the self-collected ECG database is very useful for testing and optimizing the performance of QRS detection algorithm.
